messages:
alyssa-cs: Hey team — customer reported that rerank scores are basically meaningless after they switched their embedding model yesterday. They say top results are tied/low variance. :thinking:

devin-support: Can you paste the request (sanitized) and which embed + rerank models they used?

alyssa-cs: Sure. They sent this payload for embeddings then a separate rerank call: 
```json
// embeddings request
{
  "model": "text-embed-lite-768",
  "input": ["doc1", "doc2"],
}

// rerank request
{
  "model": "rerank-v2-1024",
  "candidate_embeddings": [[...768 floats...], [...768 floats...]],
  "query_embedding": [...768 floats...]
}
```

alyssa-cs: They said no error returned; the API accepted it but scores are like 0.5/0.51/0.49 all over.

devin-support: Hmm — that screams embed dim mismatch. Rerank model expects 1024-dim vectors. If we silently accept 768 we might be doing a cheap fallback (pad/truncate/random) which would destroy scoring.

samir-eng: I pulled the internal rerank logs for their org id. We have this logged repeatedly: 
```
rerank_service: input_dim=768 expected_dim=1024 => heuristic_alignment_mode=ON
heuristic_alignment: padded_to=1024 using zeros for dims[768..1023]
scoring: cosine on padded vectors -> low variance ties observed
```

samir-eng: So we are padding with zeros currently in heuristic_alignment_mode. That will make vectors pronouncedly different and lead to compressed score range.

lina-ml: Padding zeros for missing dims is a bad idea for cross-model combos. We should fail fast with 400 + clear message pointing to docs and suggested paired models. Also we can add a compatibility check with explicit error "embedding dimension X incompatible with rerank model Y".

devin-support: Agree. For the customer: immediate workaround is to re-run embeddings with one of the rerank-compatible embed models (list: "text-embed-1024-v1", "text-embed-1024-quant"). Or convert on their side by projecting 768->1024 (not ideal).

alyssa-cs: I replied to customer with: "We see 768-dim embeddings used against a 1024-dim rerank model. Short term: regenerate embeddings with a 1024-dim model. We're escalating to engineering to make the API return a clearer 400-level error to prevent silent degradation." They appreciated the quick workaround.

devin-support: Filed a support ticket: SUP-2026-824 with logs and recommended steps. Adding eng tag.

samir-eng: I'll take a patch: change the runtime to validate dims at request time and reject with descriptive error rather than trying to align. Also add metric to track how often heuristic_alignment_mode triggers so we can measure impact.

lina-ml: Also adding a docs note and a small FAQ: "Why do my rerank scores look wrong after switching embed models?" with examples and recommended model pairings + how to check dims before calling rerank.

devin-support: Agree. For the customer we suggested a temporary script to verify dims before calling rerank: 
```bash
# quick check in bash+jq
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"text-embed-lite-768","input":["..."]}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length' && echo "dims"
```

alyssa-cs: Customer ran the 1024 embed model and re-ran rerank — scores look normal again. They asked if we can notify them when they accidentally use incompatible embed model in the future.

samir-eng: We'll add a more helpful error and SDK warnings. For now marking support ticket with workaround resolution and linking the infra issue for the permanent fix.

alyssa-cs: Closing loop with customer: workaround applied and scores back to normal; they'll re-ingest. I'll update the ticket once they finish a full run. Thanks everyone :heart:

devin-support: Nice triage. Postmortem notes: silent acceptance of mismatched dims is the root cause — follow-up PR should include unit tests and a regression test where we try various dims combos.

lina-ml: Also adding a short eval to detect if padding/truncation is applied and alert on anomalous score distributions (low variance) as a heuristic for accidental mismatches.

samir-eng: I'll push the validation change to staging and ping this thread when merged.

infra-bot: INFR-4391 updated: assignee=samir-eng status=assigned

alyssa-cs: Thanks — marking support ticket SUP-2026-824 as "waiting on engineering".

devin-support: If anyone needs the raw logs from that org id dm me and I'll paste the scrubbed snippet.

samir-eng: Merged validation to staging at 1795001450. Behavior: 400 + JSON error with expected/got dims. Will roll to prod after quick smoke.

alyssa-cs: Noted. I'll update the customer once prod roll is done.
